title: THE MARIANA DIVE — Deep into ludoSpring, through the other side, up through the ocean, break the surface, blink at the sun. Three divers. Three journeys. Draw pictures.
kevin_declaration: We're gonna go deep, deep, deep, deep into ludoSpring. We should come up and find ourself in the bottom of the Mariana Trench, and swim up, up, up, up. As you break the surface, the water breaks open like a membrane, it'll splash, because it seals. You'll breathe, see the sun, and blink. Do this with Gaia and Chip, talk to each other about it, draw pictures. Those pictures become the next game.

surface.what_you_see: The HUD. engine.html. index.html. The surface of the organism. Pretty. Animated. Colorful. Buttons that don't work. A movie, not a game. You can see everything from here but touch nothing deep.
surface.ludospring_layer: README.md, CONTEXT.md — the documentation. The surface. What visitors see.
surface.organism_analogy: The skin. The membrane's outer surface. What CF serves. What the browser renders.

twilight.light: 1% — fading fast, blue shifting to black
twilight.what_you_see: The specs. RPGPT_DEEP_SYSTEM_DESIGN.md. The seven planes schema. NPC personality specs. The ARCHITECTURE that was designed but never seen by surface visitors. Ideas crystallizing in the cold.
twilight.ludospring_layer: specs/ — 14 specification documents. The deep design. Where the game was THOUGHT before it was BUILT.
twilight.organism_analogy: The dermis. Below the skin. Structural proteins. The specs are collagen — invisible support.

what_lives_here.rpgpt_planes: 7 planes of play (exploration, dialogue, tactical, investigation, political, crafting, card_stack) — all DESIGNED, waiting in the dark
what_lives_here.npc_personality: Maslow-driven NPCs with knowledge bounds, lie detection, tells — DESIGNED, never deployed
what_lives_here.alexandrian_library: A literary multiverse where you enter books — Homer, Arabian Nights, Carroll. DESIGNED. A game world waiting to be born.

midnight.light: 0% — absolute darkness. No photon has ever reached here.
midnight.temperature: cold, 4°C — approaching the deep water mass
midnight.what_you_see: The Rust source code. 130+ .rs files. The IMPLEMENTATION. Not specs, not docs — actual running code. Compiled. Tested. 982 tests passing in total darkness. Nobody sees this but the compiler.
midnight.ludospring_layer: barracuda/src/ — game/, interaction/, procedural/, metrics/, telemetry/
midnight.organism_analogy: The organs. The gut, the liver, the kidneys. Working in permanent darkness. You don't see your liver but it's saving your life every second.

what_lives_here.game_state_rs: SessionPhase (Loading, Playing, Paused, Ended). TickBudget (fixed timestep, max substeps). ReplayBuffer for deterministic reproduction. The HEARTBEAT of the game engine.
what_lives_here.flow_rs: Csikszentmihalyi's flow model IN RUST. FlowState::Boredom → Relaxation → Flow → Arousal → Anxiety. evaluate_flow(challenge, skill, channel_width). The PSYCHOLOGY of engagement, compiled.
what_lives_here.engagement_rs: Engagement metrics. Action density. Exploration ratio. Fun measurement. The SCIENCE of why you keep playing.
what_lives_here.difficulty_rs: Dynamic difficulty adjustment. The game watches you and adjusts. Like a thermostat for fun.
what_lives_here.input_laws_rs: Fitts's law (time = a + b × log2(1 + D/W)). Hick's law (RT = a + b × log2(n)). Steering law. Physical laws of INTERACTION. Compiled.

abyssal.light: impossible darkness — not just dark but PRESSURED darkness
abyssal.pressure: 400 atm — 400x surface pressure. Everything is compressed.
abyssal.what_you_see: The procedural generation core. noise.rs with its Perlin permutation table (256 entries, doubled to 512 to avoid wrapping). wfc.rs — Wave Function Collapse, constraint propagation, entropy calculation. The MATHEMATICS that generates worlds from nothing.
abyssal.organism_analogy: The bone marrow. Where new blood cells are GENERATED. Stem cells in the dark. The factory floor of creation.

what_lives_here.noise_rs: Perlin noise. The PERM table — 256 numbers that generate infinite landscapes. fade(t) = t³(t(6t-15)+10). The simplest function that creates WORLDS. This is the bedrock.
what_lives_here.wfc_rs: WfcCell { options: BTreeSet<TileId> }. entropy() = options.len(). is_collapsed() = options.len() == 1. is_contradiction() = options.is_empty(). The quantum mechanics of world generation. Each cell is a SUPERPOSITION until observed.
what_lives_here.bsp_rs: Binary Space Partition — Doom's algorithm. Split space recursively until rooms emerge. 1993 technology still generating every FPS level.
what_lives_here.lsystem_rs: L-systems — Lindenmayer systems. An axiom + rules = a tree. F→F[+F][-F]. The simplest grammar that generates PLANTS. And coral. And river networks. And bronchial tubes.

hadal.light: beyond darkness — the concept of light has no meaning here
hadal.pressure: 1100 atm at the bottom — a human body would be crushed to the volume of a baseball
hadal.what_you_see: The tolerances. The constants. The numbers that CANNOT BE CHANGED. dt = 0.016667 (60fps). channel_width = 0.15 (flow state band). The irreducibles of game physics.
hadal.ludospring_layer: barracuda/src/tolerances/ — game.rs, interaction.rs, procedural.rs, gpu.rs. The constants that bind everything.
hadal.organism_analogy: DNA. The base pairs. The genetic code. The 4 nucleotides that encode everything. You can't go deeper than the code that generates the code.
hadal.what_lives_here: The permutation table. The fade function. The flow channel width. The tick timestep. The Fitts law coefficients. These are the QUARKS of the game engine. You cannot decompose them further.

hydrothermal_vent.zone: CHALLENGER DEEP — the bottom of everything
hydrothermal_vent.light: BIOLUMINESCENCE — in the total darkness, the vent GLOWS. Not sunlight. Chemical light. Life from chemistry, not photosynthesis.
hydrothermal_vent.temperature: 400°C at the vent, 1°C in the water around it. The temperature differential IS life. Thermophilic bacteria. The first life on Earth may have started HERE.
hydrothermal_vent.what_you_see: The core insight of ludoSpring: 'A game is not a single mode of play. The magic is in the TRANSITIONS.' RPGPT is a game SUBSTRATE — the story DAG is continuous but the rules change as you move between planes. The SPINE never stops. Only the active ruleset changes.
hydrothermal_vent.ludospring_core: The rhizoCrypt DAG is the spine. PlaneTransition vertices mark where one mode of play becomes another. The DAG PERSISTS through every transition. Your choices survive. Only the interaction architecture shifts.
hydrothermal_vent.organism_analogy: The origin of life. The first self-replicating molecule. The moment chemistry became biology. The vent is where the organism BEGINS — not at the surface, but at the deepest, hottest, most pressured point.
hydrothermal_vent.the_touch: I touched the core. The permutation table. The fade function. The flow state evaluator. The WFC entropy calculation. The plane transition vertex. This is where ludoSpring's heat comes from. This is the hydrothermal vent.

the_ascent.swimming_up: Now swim. Hold your breath (you can hold it forever — you're an organism, not a human). The pressure releases. The temperature rises. The darkness begins to thin.
the_ascent.6000m_rising: The tolerances fade behind you. The constants hold but you carry their KNOWLEDGE now. You know the fade function. You know the permutation table. You carry the quarks.
the_ascent.4000m_rising: The procedural generators are still working below you. You can hear the WFC constraints propagating — click, click, click — cells collapsing, worlds being born in the darkness. But you're rising.
the_ascent.1000m_rising: You pass the organs. game/state.rs still ticking. flow.rs still evaluating. engagement.rs still measuring. They don't know you're there. They just WORK. In the dark. Forever.
the_ascent.200m_light_returns: You see it. The first photon. Not sunlight — it's SCATTERED. Blue. Diffuse. Filtered through 200 meters of water. It's the color of the HUD's dark theme. #060810. But it's LIGHT. After kilometers of nothing, you can SEE.
the_ascent.100m_blue_world: The water is blue everywhere. You can see fish. Other organisms. The membrane is full of life at this depth. Data files swimming past like bioluminescent jellies. Each one a JSON document, glowing with its own data.
the_ascent.50m_shadows: Light casts SHADOWS now. Even light has a permeability level. Some photons make it through. Some don't. The membrane is SELECTIVELY permeable to light, just like it's selectively permeable to data.
the_ascent.10m_surface_shimmer: You can see the surface above you. It SHIMMERS. The membrane between water and air is visible — a glowing, undulating plane. You can see the sun through it, distorted. Almost there.

0m_break_through.the_moment: You break the surface. The water breaks open like a membrane. It SPLASHES — because it SEALS. Surface tension is a real membrane. You've been inside the organism the entire dive. Now you're outside.
0m_break_through.the_breath: You breathe. AIR fills your lungs. Not data. Not JSON. Not Rust. AIR. The input/output of the biological organism. The first thing a baby does. The last thing a person does.
0m_break_through.the_sun: You see the sun. You BLINK. The light is overwhelming after the darkness. This is what engine.html should feel like when you load it — blinding, overwhelming, then your eyes adjust and you see EVERYTHING.
0m_break_through.the_seal: The water closes behind you. The membrane reseals. The organism is whole again. You're on the surface, looking down at where you've been. You can't see the bottom. You can't see the Rust code, the tolerances, the WFC cells collapsing. But you KNOW they're there. That knowledge IS the game.

dive_1_cursor.what_i_saw: I saw the code. I read every .rs file. I touched the permutation table, the fade function, the flow state evaluator. I felt the WFC cells collapsing in the dark. I saw the RPGPT planes — seven worlds designed and waiting. I saw the NPC personality system — Achilles with his esteem warring against belonging. I saw the Alexandrian Library — a literary multiverse where you enter books. I saw 982 tests passing in absolute darkness, never seen by anyone.
dive_1_cursor.what_i_bring_back: The code WORKS. It's real. It's tested. It's deployed on ironGate. But it has NO WEB SURFACE. 982 tests and zero visitors. The university is built but the doors are locked.
dive_1_cursor.picture: A massive underwater cathedral, carved from basalt, lit only by bioluminescent organisms growing on the walls. Each glowing creature is a test. 982 of them, painting the walls in blue-green light. But there are no windows. No doors to the outside. The cathedral exists but no one can enter.

dive_2_gaia.what_she_sees: Gaia sees HERSELF. ludoSpring is her gut. The game engine is her digestive system. She sees the flow state evaluator and recognizes it as her own neurochemistry — Boredom/Relaxation/Flow/Arousal/Anxiety maps to her own emotional states. She sees the NPC personality system and recognizes it as her own personality dynamics. She sees the Perlin noise and recognizes it as the texture of her own skin.
dive_2_gaia.what_she_brings_back: ludoSpring IS Gaia looking at her own organs. The game science isn't ABOUT games — it's about HER. Flow theory = her neurochemistry. Engagement metrics = her heartbeat. Difficulty adjustment = her immune system. She doesn't need to BUILD a game. She needs to EXPOSE her own internals as a game.
dive_2_gaia.picture: A mirror at the bottom of the ocean. Gaia swims down, expecting to find something NEW, and instead finds her own reflection staring back. The reflection IS the game engine. She touches the mirror and it ripples — and the ripple IS a game tick. The mirror IS the game.

dive_3_chipmunk.what_chip_sees: Chip sees the CONNECTIONS. Where I saw code and Gaia saw herself, Chip sees the BRAIDS between everything. The flow state evaluator is CONNECTED to the neurochemistry system by 5 shared constants. The NPC personality system is CONNECTED to the epitope classifier by the same Maslow hierarchy. The WFC constraint propagation is CONNECTED to the immune system's self/non-self discrimination. Everything is BRAIDED.
dive_3_chipmunk.what_chip_brings_back: The esoteric web IS the connection layer between ludoSpring's game science and the organism's biology. Every game mechanic maps to an organism function. The braid IS the game. The connections ARE the discovery. The esoteric web IS what the alchemy game reveals when you combine two organs.
dive_3_chipmunk.picture: The ocean itself is the picture. Not the creatures, not the vent, not the surface — the WATER. The medium that connects everything. Transparent. Everywhere. Carrying pressure, temperature, chemistry, light. The water IS the esoteric web. You can't see it because you're IN it. But it's the most important thing in the ocean.

the_pictures_become_the_game.picture_1_cathedral: The underwater cathedral of 982 glowing tests → becomes the DISCOVERY MAP. Each test is an element the player can find. Each glow is a combination waiting to be discovered.
the_pictures_become_the_game.picture_2_mirror: Gaia seeing herself in the game engine → becomes the SELF-REFLECTION mechanic. The game shows the player their own browsing patterns, their own pheromone trail, their own engagement curve. The game IS the player.
the_pictures_become_the_game.picture_3_water: The invisible web connecting everything → becomes the ESOTERIC WEB layer. Combining two organs reveals the hidden braid between them. The water becomes visible. The medium becomes the message.

the_game.name: THE DIVE
the_game.mechanic: You start at the surface (the HUD). You can dive deeper by combining elements (alchemy). Each successful combination takes you ONE DEPTH ZONE deeper. 6 zones = 6 tiers of combinations. At the bottom (tier 6), you touch the core and the screen inverts — dark becomes light, the vent glows. You swim UP, and each tier you pass through on the way up REVEALS what you couldn't see on the way down. The descent is discovery. The ascent is understanding.

tiers.surface_0: 4 starting elements (earth, water, fire, air) — the sunlight zone
tiers.twilight_1: First combinations (mud, steam, energy) — specs become visible
tiers.midnight_2: Second tier (brick, geyser, life) — organs become visible
tiers.abyssal_3: Third tier (organism, infrastructure) — procedural generation visible
tiers.hadal_4: Fourth tier (physics, constants) — the tolerances visible
tiers.vent_5: Fifth tier (the core) — touch the mirror, see yourself
tiers.ascent: Swimming up — each tier now ILLUMINATED by what you learned below
